sources.title: Ecommerce UX Audit: How to Find What's Hurting Your Conversion
sources.takeaway: Checkout and shipping/tax surprises are leading abandonment drivers; audit against heuristics.

sources.title: Ecommerce UX That Converts: 2026 Guide
sources.takeaway: Reviews near add-to-cart, guest checkout, free-shipping progress.

sources.title: GEO for ecommerce: How to get your products cited by AI search engines
sources.takeaway: Complete Product schema, crawlable pages, answer-first copy.

sources.title: AEO/GEO playbook for Shopify brands
sources.takeaway: Brand-owned FAQs, policies, sizing guides are what AI cites.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization for Shopify
sources.takeaway: Allow AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot etc.); claims unverified by OpenAI docs.

sources.title: Universal Commerce Protocol
sources.takeaway: UCP lets agents discover, cart and check out; store already exposes /.well-known/ucp, agents.md, llms.txt.

sources.title: The State of Shopify Performance in 2026
sources.takeaway: INP and LCP are the hard CWV metrics on app-heavy Shopify stores; use field data. Pass-rate stats conflict across sources.

sources.title: Missing field shippingDetails in offers
sources.takeaway: shippingDetails/hasMerchantReturnPolicy warnings are common on Shopify; can be supplied via Merchant Center. Unverified vs Google docs.

sources.title: Ecommerce Product Page Optimization 2026
sources.takeaway: Estimated-delivery-date messaging is a high-impact low-effort test; not primary data.

sources.title: How To Add Merchant Listing Structured Data
sources.takeaway: Product markup with price, availability, shipping and returns makes pages eligible for merchant listings; missing fields trigger warnings.

sources.title: Merchant Return Policy Structured Data
sources.takeaway: hasMerchantReturnPolicy can live at Organization level; merchantReturnDays required for finite windows.

sources.title: More ways to share your shipping and returns policies with Google
sources.takeaway: Org-level shipping policy markup now supported; Merchant Center/Search Console settings take precedence.

sources.title: Fragrances in Cosmetics
sources.takeaway: Fragrance can be listed as 'Fragrance' on label; MoCRA fragrance-allergen labeling rule still to be set. Confirm compliance with counsel.

sources.title: MoCRA overview
sources.takeaway: Small-business exemptions cover registration/listing/GMP, not labeling; product listing with ingredients is annual.

sources.title: Agentic Commerce for Shopify Merchants 2026
sources.takeaway: Agentic Storefronts reportedly on by default for eligible US merchants; thin product data means exclusion from AI shortlists. Unverified vs Shopify docs.

sources.title: Ecommerce Technical SEO Statistics 2026
sources.takeaway: CWV targets LCP<=2.5s, INP<=200ms, CLS<=0.1; conversion-loss stats are vendor-reported, directional only.

sources.title: What Makes a High-Converting Shopify Product Page?
sources.takeaway: PDP should answer 5 buyer questions: what, total cost, fit, arrival, what if wrong.

sources.title: ChatGPT Product Feed (2026) specification
sources.takeaway: Feed quality matters more than enrolment; ChatGPT feed is push-based and needs 9 required fields; unverified vs OpenAI docs.

sources.title: LLM SEO for ecommerce brands
sources.takeaway: No independent evidence llms.txt raises citations; AI traffic stats unverified; reviews/community drive citations.

sources.title: AI in Ecommerce Statistics
sources.takeaway: Reddit ~29% of third-party AI citations; Ahrefs: <9% of AI citations come from Google top-10 URLs.

sources.title: Google AI Mode for Shopping: How It Works and What Merchants Need to Do
sources.takeaway: Keep page price/availability/schema and Merchant Center feed consistent; free listings may surface in AI Mode (unverified by Google).

sources.title: Shopify Checkout UX Best Practices: 30 Design Principles for 2026
sources.takeaway: Mobile-first checkout, Shop Pay, collapsed sticky order summary; stats unsourced (directional).

sources.title: AEO for Ecommerce: How to Get Your Products Cited in AI Shopping Results
sources.takeaway: Structured data + feed quality + third-party mentions drive AI shopping citations; figures unverified.

sources.title: What is AI Mode and how should ecommerce brands optimize for it
sources.takeaway: Optimize for AI Mode via crawlable pages and Merchant Center data, not special markup.
